sentences.text: Supplementary affidavit filed by the counsel for the applicant, is taken on record.
2.  As per office report dated 24.03.2025, notice of the present application has been served upon the informant personally.
However, no one appears on behalf of the informant nor any counter affidavit has been filed.

3. Heard counsel for the applicant and Sri V.P. Tripathi, learned AGA for the State and perused the material on record.
4.
The applicant was granted interim anticipatory bail by this Court vide order dated 05.02.2025.

The order is quoted herein below:-
"1.

The instant application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant in Case Crime No. 107 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Dumariyaganj,
District Siddharthnagar.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is the married sister-in-law of the deceased and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The deceased was married with the brother of the applicant in the year 2019.
In the alleged incident the brother of the applicant (husband of the deceased) has also received injuries, while trying to save the deceased.

At the time of alleged incident,
the applicant was living separately with her husband at Lucknow.

It is next contended that during the pendency of investigation the applicant was granted anticipatory bail till the submission of police report vide order dated 05.11.2024 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C.
No. 10616 of 2024, Sanno @ Rubiya Khatoon v. State of U.P..

entities.text: Sanno @ Rubiya Khatoon v. State of U.P
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The investigation has been completed and the charge-sheet has been submitted.
The applicant had cooperated in the investigation.
No custodial interrogation is required.
The applicant has been summoned by the court concerned.
The applicant has no criminal antecedents.
The applicant has apprehension of her arrest in the above mentioned case.
3. Matter requires consideration.
4. Learned A.G.A. has accepted notice on behalf of the State- opposite party.

sentences.text: 5. Issue notice to the informant.
6. The opposite parties are granted four weeks' time to file counter affidavit.
Rejoinder affidavit, if any, may be filed within a week thereafter.

7. Place this case on 26.03.2025 in the additional cause list.
8.

Till the next date of listing, in the event of arrest the applicant- Sanno @ Rabiya Khatoon in the aforesaid case crime shall be released on interim anticipatory bail on her furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 50,000/- with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) the applicant shall make herself available on each and every date fixed in the matter by the court concerned.

(ii) the applicant shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court.
(iii) the applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the Court and if she has passport the same shall be deposited by her before the concerned court.
9. In case, the applicant does not co
- operate in the proceedings of the trial, this order shall stand automatically recalled/vacated and the applicant shall be taken into custody, forthwith.
10. Further, in default of any of the conditions, the court concerned is at liberty to pass appropriate orders for enforcing and compelling the same."

5. Counsel for the applicant submits that pursuant to the order dated 05.02.2025, the applicant had furnished bail bonds before the court concerned and is appearing before the court on the dates fixed and contesting the proceedings.
The applicant has not misused the liberty of interim anticipatory bail.
The applicant is a lady and has no criminal antecedents.
In case, the applicant is released on anticipatory bail, till the conclusion of trial she will not misuse the said liberty.
6. Learned A.G.A. and the counsel for the informant have opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid submissions from the record.

7. Having regard to the submissions as recorded in the order dated 05.02.2025, considering the nature of accusations, antecedents of the applicant and, in particular, the fact that the applicant is appearing before the concerned court on the dates fixed, charge-sheet has been filed, the applicant had cooperated in the investigation, no custodial interrogation is required, no violation of conditions or misuse of liberty of interim anticipatory bail has been pointed out by learned A.G.A.,
without commenting on merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be Sanno @ Rabiya Khatoon vs State Of U.P. on 6 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14625981/

10. The application stands disposed of.
